name: Nuclear risk
summary: No US–Russia arms limits since February; no test or alert change
state: New START expired in February 2026 with no replacement; Russia says it will keep to the old limits if the US does. Trump said on 31 Oct that 'one or two' targets remain in Iran. No nuclear test or change in alert levels had been reported as of 2 Nov.
for_you: No change in official UK guidance. Risk remains elevated but not acute.
rubric_hit: Arms control lapsed; no test or alert change = Watch

sources.title: CBS News — Russia says it will stick to limits in expired New START treaty
Gulf News — Trump says US still has to take care of one or two targets in Iran

why: Nuclear use anywhere would be a civilisational shock; arms-control treaties are weaker than at any time since the 1960s.
drivers: Threats in active wars, testing, doctrine changes, arms-control collapse, proliferation.

rubric.alert: A nuclear test, changes in deployment/alert levels, or threatened use in an active conflict.
rubric.watch: Explicit threats, unusual exercises, doctrine changes, or arms-control lapses without replacement.
rubric.normal: No explicit nuclear threats or tests; arms-control dialogue active.
